name: Pillow 65 × 65
notes: Generic pillow, not a specific product: 65 × 65 cm, the Swiss standard size, lying flat and about 14 cm high. Put two at the head end of a 160 cm bed, on the duvet (duvet-200x210) or straight on the mattress; they then move with the bed. Pushed to the head end they leave about 18 cm of the duvet free before the bedspread (bedspread-quilted-240x260) begins.
